scope: Four verified additions; original twelve results, resource records and checkpoint coverage retained unchanged.

rows.optimizer_qualification_scope: Native optimizer-family membership; not a count of parameters observed to receive gradients
rows.restored_requires_grad_scope: requires_grad at the restored task boundary; not observed gradient updates
rows.auxiliary_numeric_sum_scope: Explicit disjoint auxiliary groups; nested class-mean/covariance subtotals are not added twice

replay.scope: Referenced source-file bytes and decoded RGB payload are separate quantities, not additional in-RAM image copies; metadata/container overhead excluded

training_execution.gpu_peak_scope: Resumed process only; earlier-process peaks are not reconstructed.

original_resource_definitions.parameter_count: Native timm parameter-name registry matched exact completed checkpoint names/shapes. Counts use tensor.numel and actual dtype; buffers counted separately. No byte-to-parameter inference.
original_resource_definitions.gradient_eligible: Parameters selected by native optimizer families. Frozen D/analytic learning is counted separately, not called zero learning. Reader CE work is shared with fixed ER.
original_resource_definitions.active_inference_backbones: Networks whose forward participates in the configured final head. HT/PSB use one plastic body at inference and two bodies during training; current full head uses anchor plus plastic body.
original_resource_definitions.training_frozen_anchor_parameter_bytes: Extra fixed reference branch, excluded from deployed HT/PSB inference. Current reference branch remains active at inference. Shared one frozen body is its deployment body, not an extra anchor.
original_resource_definitions.shared_numeric_state_bytes: SharedPredictorBasis.resource_bytes sums G,C,feature_sum,counts,D and derived weights/intercept. Derived posterior is reconstructed on restore and absent from serialized predictor state.
original_resource_definitions.history_statistics_bytes: TransportHistory.resource_bytes includes anchor_G,anchor_C,current_G,current_C,counts,head,last_transport. Reported deployment_analytic_head_bytes is already included: do not add it again.
original_resource_definitions.plastic_statistics_bytes: Transport bytes plus SharedPredictorBasis resident bytes. Includes auxiliary transport ridge head and basis state. Deployment analytic head is a representation of basis weights/intercept already charged in basis bytes; no extra summation.
original_resource_definitions.current_numeric_payload_bytes: CurrentMethod.resource_bytes dictionary: encoder_weights (anchor/main/libraries), statistics (G,C), readouts (W0,V), resident_anchor_cache (memory_base), optimizer_state (both optimizer state_dicts). These are logical tensor bytes, not CUDA peak or serialized bytes.
original_resource_definitions.replay_raw_payload_bytes: ReplayMemory.payload_bytes sums ndarray.nbytes OR width*height*3 for each external image path, then adds 16 bytes per record. CIF arrays are raw RGB; ImageNet-R path payload is RGB-decoded equivalent, not compressed JPEG bytes, path-string bytes, or measured resident decoded memory.
original_resource_definitions.numeric_checkpoint_payload_bytes: runner numeric_bytes(model.checkpoint_core()): recursive tensor/ndarray logical payload. Excludes outer stages/RNG container, Python/object/RawRecord image contents and strings; does not deduplicate repeated references. Not checkpoint file size.
original_resource_definitions.checkpoint_file_bytes: Actual complete serialized checkpoint.pt size bound to its SHA; includes serialization and native state/replay representation. This is the disk number, distinct from resident logical numeric bytes.
original_resource_definitions.actual_run_wall_seconds: runner begins after model/data initialization and resume setup; includes training/evaluation, stage checkpoint/progress I/O, final core accounting and metrics-by-head construction before the wall field; excludes imports/setup, later CE report assembly and final results.json write. If resumed, it measures only this process remaining work even though stage records include inherited prefix.
original_resource_definitions.stage_wall_seconds: Starts before incremental_train, ends after evaluation and after_task, before stage checkpoint write. Sum need not equal run wall.
original_resource_definitions.shared_native_ce_seconds: Fixed ER native CE adaptation wall with device synchronization. Replayed by HT/PSB, not executed anew by readers; count once per dataset in actual campaign compute totals.
original_resource_definitions.executor_wall_seconds: CE wrapper actual call wall including identity guards, serialization/load, state and RNG work; record mode includes native CE, replay mode does not.
original_resource_definitions.gpu_peak_allocated_bytes: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated of this process after reset before model/data creation. Excludes CUDA context, reserved/unallocated pool, other processes and CPU state. Reader peak does not measure full independent HT/PSB training peak.
original_resource_definitions.ce_cache_disk: Sealed execution/recovery files, counted once by dataset donor asset; separate from algorithm replay-image budget and resident auxiliary arrays.
original_resource_definitions.rng_and_optimizer: Outer runner RNG plus method-local replay RNG are recovery state. ER/HT/PSB reset AdamW per stage and save stage boundaries; Joint saves completed fit. Current persists two AdamW states and progress; dynamic phase requires_grad is not eligibility.
original_resource_definitions.current_overlap_rule: Count main/anchor/library Parameters once; encoder_weights is their plus buffer payload, not additional storage. Current auxiliary sum excludes encoder_weights and includes statistics/readouts/resident cache/persistent optimizer tensors. Optimizer tensors are not additional neural parameters.
original_resource_definitions.current_successful_work: Actual module/backbone successful steps and episode attempts/skips; no fixed step count is required, including the two skipped CIFAR task0 episodes. Terminal cumulative encoding counters are not summed across stages.
